# Known skips for the rust_test job in .github/workflows/sami-rust-test.yml: tests
# that skip themselves on the runner (print `skipped: <reason>`, or a word the
# skip scan in .github/sami/rust-test.sh knows, and return), though the runner
# cannot give them their precondition. The job passes only when exactly the
# tests named here skip. It fails when a test that is not named skips, and
# when a named test runs: remove its line then. No skip is allowed, so a line
# here needs the reason no GitHub-hosted runner can run the test, its owner,
# and the change that will make it run.
# One per line: <bazel test target> <libtest test name>  <reason, owner, fix>.
